profiles.trustBoundary: Advisory until a workflow records live output from http://127.0.0.1:6006/mcp.
profiles.repairHint: Run bun --filter @archon/ui-lab storybook, then verify http://127.0.0.1:6006/mcp.

profiles.trustBoundary: Advisory until a Claude node invokes the configured MCP server and stores run evidence.
profiles.repairHint: Use npx -y @playwright/mcp@latest --headless --isolated and keep browser tests deterministic.

profiles.trustBoundary: shadcn MCP setup must be performed through the official CLI init command, not a hand-written server command.
profiles.repairHint: Run bunx shadcn@latest info --cwd packages/ui-lab and the official mcp init command when user-approved.

profiles.trustBoundary: No official Radix MCP is claimed; use source/docs evidence and Storybook interaction tests.
profiles.repairHint: Do not add a Radix MCP profile unless an official Radix MCP exists and is verified.

profiles.trustBoundary: No official Tailwind MCP is claimed; use source/docs evidence and CSS/theme validation.
profiles.repairHint: Do not add a Tailwind MCP profile unless an official Tailwind MCP exists and is verified.
